source: schemas/release-schema.json index_columns (sda-release-sample-1) plus atlas metadata fields

catalog.gsm: GEO sample (canonical GSM of its content group)
catalog.gse: all GEO series listing the GSM, joined with '+'; the split is computed on this string
catalog.published_gse: series folder of the sample: samples/<published_gse>/<gsm>
catalog.source_pipeline: sda-all (agent standardization, independent scorer) or hesrt (H&E Visium/ST, human review)
catalog.source_release: SDA-All scorer version of the batch, sda-all-gap-20261009, or hesrt-v1.3
catalog.technology: technology as written by the authors
catalog.expression_state: counts (integer X) / non-integer / unknown (SDA-All: as declared and scored)
catalog.coordinate_units: units of obsm['spatial']: um / pixel / native_grid / unstated
catalog.um_per_unit: micrometres per coordinate unit when known
catalog.has_spatial_um: obsm['spatial_um'] present (micrometre copy of non-um coordinates)
catalog.image_um_per_px: micrometres per image.tif pixel when known
catalog.image_registration: VERIFIED / PARTIAL / UNRESOLVED / FAILED / ABSENT (modality acceptance), WITHHELD (HESRT review FAIL: no image delivered), HESRT_HUMAN_REVIEW, empty = no registrable image
catalog.segmentation: cell / nucleus boundary acceptance (sources in sample.json)
catalog.molecules_use: positions_only: molecules without usable cell IDs
catalog.flags: units_unstated / attested / summary_features_in_matrix / hesrt_review_fail / hesrt_fail_image_released / image_partial_coverage / image_review_fail
catalog.review_decision: latest author review of this expression file: PASS / FAIL / UNSURE
catalog.aliases: GSMs with identical content not listed as rows
catalog.frozen_paper_evaluation_eligible: false for daily additions after the paper release (not part of the frozen paper evaluation cohort); empty for paper-release samples [client description]
catalog.review_kind: kind of review that admitted a daily addition, e.g. human; empty for paper-release samples [client description]
catalog.review_model: model of a delegated review, when one was used; empty otherwise [client description]
catalog.review_evidence_sha256: SHA256 of delegated review evidence, when recorded [client description]

metadata.disease: disease as reported in GEO; not harmonized to an ontology (atlas-sample-metadata.jsonl)
metadata.condition: condition or group label as reported in GEO; not harmonized
metadata.age: age as reported, with its original unit; not harmonized
metadata.sex: sex as reported (e.g. male / M / female / F); not harmonized
metadata.donor_id: donor identifier as reported, when available
metadata.publication_pmid: PubMed ID linked to the sample or its series
metadata.counts_ready: source-bound counts-capability check: VERIFIED / UNRESOLVED / ABSENT, or NOT_RECORDED (HESRT)
